caption: The drawing depicts three objects: at the top, there is an opened rectangular case with scalloped edges, featuring a gold-colored hinge in the center. The left side of the case has an ornate, red velvet interior with a decorative pattern and an oval center. The right side holds an oval portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat, dark clothing, and holding a long object, set against an orange and gold-colored mat. Both sides of the case have a black outer frame with wavy edges. Below the open case, there is a closed case rendered in shades of gray and black, also with a scalloped edge and a highly ornamental design on its surface, featuring floral motifs and a central oval pattern. The composition places the open case at the top and the closed case below it, with all objects centered on a plain background.
title: Daguerreotype Case
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
